t: The Resolva Path and Drive is a fast-acting, non-glyphosate weed and moss killer designed for effective control on hard surfaces. This powerful herbicide is ideal for maintaining clean paths and driveways, quickly tackling unwanted growth. Effects are visible within hours of treatment, providing rapid results for trade professionals and property owners. It can be applied all year round, offering flexible use for various projects. The formula also targets algae and grasses, ensuring comprehensive clearance of common outdoor nuisances.
b: Ideal to Use on Paths & Drives
